title: Neural Geometry Image-Based Representations with Optimal Transport (OT)
tldr_zh: Ricci flow 共形参数化后用 OT 校正面积畸变，得到保面积 geometry image，低分辨率 mipmap 经单趟 CNN 超分重建网格，CR=64 时 CD/HD 优于 NCS 等基线
tldr_en: OT-corrected area-preserving geometry images enable single-pass CNN super-resolution mesh reconstruction with continuous GPU LoD

key_numbers.number: CD=2.4637, HD=4.5148 (Ours) vs CD=2.7152, HD=4.8234 (Neural Subdivision) at CR=64
CR=64 (128x128) is the sweet spot: CD=0.009, HD=1.085
Learning rate 5e-5, Adam, eta1=eta2=0.5, 16-bit RGB PNG, 1024x1024 geometry image
